items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral and others release open letter defending open-weight AI models
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral 等聯署公開信捍衛開權重 AI 模型
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 a coalition of more than 25 organizations including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral, Hugging Face, IBM and Y Combinator published the letter “Open Weights and American AI Leadership.” It argues open-weight models expand access, strengthen competition, improve safety through transparency and scrutiny, and help sustain U.S. technological leadership. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made the letter the subject of his first post on X; Sam Altman and Elon Musk publicly endorsed the position.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026年7月24日，NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral、Hugging Face、IBM 與 Y Combinator 等超過25個組織發布《Open Weights and American AI Leadership》公開信。信中主張開權重模型能擴大使用門檻、強化競爭、透過透明度與社群檢視提升安全，並有助維持美國技術領導地位。NVIDIA CEO 黃仁勳以此作為他在 X 的首發貼文；Sam Altman 與 Elon Musk 公開表態支持。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter marks a rare public alignment of closed-model labs, open-source players and the leading GPU maker against premature restrictions. It reframes open weights as a safety and sovereignty asset rather than a pure risk, but policymakers’ response and any concrete legislative impact remain unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這封信罕見地讓封閉模型實驗室、開源玩家與主要 GPU 廠商公開站同一陣線，反對過早限制。它把開權重重新定位為安全與主權資產而非單純風險，但政策制定者如何回應、以及實際立法影響仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 世界需要前沿閉源模型，也需要前沿開權重模型。

brief_en: Quiet on new frontier model releases. The day’s clear signal: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral and others jointly defend open-weight models in a public letter; Jensen Huang’s first X post and endorsements from Altman and Musk amplify the industry stance on U.S. AI leadership.
brief_zh: 今日無重大新模型發布。明確訊號是 NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral 等聯合公開信捍衛開權重模型；黃仁勳 X 首帖與 Altman、Musk 的支持，放大產業對美國 AI 領導力的立場。
